SELECT CONCAT(YEAR(u.created_at), '-W', WEEK(u.created_at, 1)) AS date_label, COUNT(u.user_id) AS signup_count FROM users u
JOIN user_roles ur ON u.user_id = ur.user_id JOIN roles r ON ur.role_id = r.role_id
r.role = #{roleName}
AND u.created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 12 WEEK)
GROUP BY date_label ORDER BY date_label ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(u.created_at, '%Y-%m') AS date_label, COUNT(u.user_id) AS signup_count FROM users u
JOIN user_roles ur ON u.user_id = ur.user_id JOIN roles r ON ur.role_id = r.role_id
r.role = #{roleName}
AND u.created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 12 MONTH)
GROUP BY date_label ORDER BY date_label ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(u.created_at, '%Y') AS date_label, COUNT(u.user_id) AS signup_count FROM users u
JOIN user_roles ur ON u.user_id = ur.user_id JOIN roles r ON ur.role_id = r.role_id
r.role = #{roleName}
GROUP BY date_label ORDER BY date_label ASC
